summary.callChainContext: In the typical coaching flow for 'explain answer', the call chain is: _explainAnswer → _generateNextBestStep (S123, line 1123) → _identifyLearningPatterns (S124, line 1277) → _suggestFocusAreas (S125, line 1412). Each independently calls MayLearnerState.getTopicProgress() and MayLearnerState.load() — three sequential redundant calls to the same data source for the same question with no caching between them.
summary.migrationPlan: Single call to MayLearnerState.computeEvidenceGraph() at the dispatch level (handleAction), pass graph down through call chain as parameter. All 49 directly replaceable accesses become property reads from the graph. The 1 'replaceableWithAdaptation' (line 1348, _learnerState.sessions scan) requires extending computeEvidenceGraph to include calculationMissCount per topic. The 1 'notReplaceable' is the same line 1348 if the _learnerState.sessions structure differs from standard data.sessions — verify and either extend graph or refactor the alternate session format.
summary.estimatedImpact: Eliminates ~35 redundant MayLearnerState calls per coaching interaction. Reduces duplicated code by eliminating 7 patternName maps and 6 sectionName maps (13 inline copies). Centralizes threshold gating through single evidence graph.
